boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-extra-cost ways for eligible URI students to spend time together on and around the Kingston campus.

cards.title: Walk the URI Gardens
cards.subtitle: Behind the URI greenhouse complex, Kingston Campus
cards.notes: Meet for a daylight walk through the collections, then pause to compare what you notice. Stay on paths and leave plants and labels undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: A free, year-round outdoor garden stroll.
cards.evidence_claim: URI states that the URI Gardens are free to visit and open every day from sunrise to sundown.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor garden access is free; visit between sunrise and sundown and follow posted rules.

cards.title: Take a North Woods trail walk
cards.subtitle: North of Flagg Road beside the Kingston Campus
cards.notes: Choose an established trail for a daylight walk with a friend. Check for ticks afterward, stay on trail, and do not disturb research markers.
cards.short_summary: A campus woodland outing for walking and nature watching.
cards.evidence_claim: URI describes North Woods as a campus space for hiking, birdwatching, running, dog walking, and mindfulness meditation; recreational use is pedestrian-only.
cards.access_notes: No admission or purchase is listed for pedestrian recreation. Use established trails; camping, fires, and motorized vehicles are prohibited.

cards.title: Settle into the 24-Hour Study Room
cards.subtitle: Carothers Library and Learning Commons, Kingston Campus
cards.notes: Bring coursework or a quiet project and meet after regular library activity winds down. URI students should have their ID ready for overnight entry.
cards.short_summary: An overnight-capable study meet-up for URI ID holders.
cards.evidence_claim: URI Libraries says its 24-Hour Study Room is open every night during the academic year and requires a URI ID card swipe after 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: No separate admission is listed. During the academic year, URI ID access is required after 11 p.m.; confirm library notices before visiting.

cards.title: Book a group study room
cards.subtitle: Lower Level and floors 1–3, Carothers Library
cards.notes: Reserve a room online for a low-key work session, presentation practice, or shared reading. Keep the plan small enough for the room you select.
cards.short_summary: Bookable library rooms for collaborative study.
cards.evidence_claim: URI Libraries lists group study rooms on the Lower Level and floors 1 through 3 of the Kingston University Library, reservable through its booking system.
cards.access_notes: No separate admission or room fee is listed. Availability and reservation requirements apply.

cards.entity_name: Anna Fascitelli Fitness and Wellness Center
cards.title: Work out at Fascitelli
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation, Kingston Campus
cards.notes: Plan a workout together, bring your URI ID, and use equipment on a first-come basis. Choose routines that suit everyone in your group.
cards.short_summary: A student-access fitness hang with no separate membership purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: URI says student Campus Recreation membership is included with tuition and includes access to the Anna Fascitelli Fitness and Wellness Center.
cards.access_notes: Eligible enrolled URI students have membership included with tuition; present valid URI ID or membership access. Guests may pay separately.

cards.title: Move around at Mackal Field House
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation, Kingston Campus
cards.notes: Use the facility for an active break with friends when its schedule permits. Bring your URI ID and follow staff directions and posted activity rules.
cards.short_summary: An indoor recreation option covered by eligible student membership.
cards.evidence_claim: URI says student Campus Recreation membership is included with tuition and includes access to Mackal Field House.
cards.access_notes: Eligible enrolled URI students have membership included with tuition; facility hours and scheduled use affect availability.

cards.title: Meet for a swim at Tootell
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation, Kingston Campus
cards.notes: Check the pool schedule, bring swimwear and your URI ID, and meet during an available recreation session. Follow lifeguard and facility instructions.
cards.short_summary: A student-membership swim outing when the pool schedule allows.
cards.evidence_claim: URI says student Campus Recreation membership is included with tuition and includes access to the Tootell Aquatic Center.
cards.access_notes: Eligible enrolled URI students have membership included with tuition. Pool access depends on posted hours, lifeguard coverage, and facility rules.

cards.entity_name: URI Campus Recreation Group Exercise Classes
cards.title: Try a group exercise class
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation facilities, Kingston Campus
cards.notes: Pick a class that fits your group’s comfort level and register when the window opens. Arrive ready to check in with your URI ID or member pass.
cards.short_summary: Scheduled fitness classes with no separate class charge for members.
cards.evidence_claim: URI states that all group exercise classes are offered free of charge to students and members, with advance registration required.
cards.access_notes: Free to students and members, but preregistration is required and access requires valid URI ID or membership pass.

cards.title: Gather at the outdoor recreation fields
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation, Kingston Campus
cards.notes: Coordinate a casual outdoor activity or meet-up when the fields are not reserved. Check the facility schedule and leave the area as you found it.
cards.short_summary: Campus recreation fields for eligible member use.
cards.evidence_claim: URI lists Outdoor Recreation Fields among its Campus Recreation facilities, which are open to people with a Campus Recreation membership.
cards.access_notes: Eligible enrolled URI students have membership included with tuition. Field access is subject to reservations, conditions, and posted policies.

cards.title: Walk the URI 5K Run Course
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation, Kingston Campus
cards.notes: Choose a walking pace that works for everyone and use the marked route as a reason to catch up. Check conditions and remain aware of traffic.
cards.short_summary: A structured campus route for a no-extra-cost walking hang.
cards.evidence_claim: URI lists the 5K Run Course as a Campus Recreation facility; URI states enrolled students’ Campus Recreation membership is included with tuition.
cards.access_notes: Eligible enrolled URI students have membership included with tuition. Check current campus and recreation guidance before using the route.

warnings: Campus Recreation access is free at point of use for eligible enrolled URI students because membership is included with tuition; guests and non-enrolled visitors may face charges.
Library rooms, recreation facilities, and outdoor areas can have changing hours, reservations, closures, or access requirements.
